Name: Prof. Vijyendra Pandey
Bio: Prof. Vijyendra Pandey is Professor and Head of the Department of Psychology at the Central University of Karnataka. His vision and sustained leadership were instrumental in establishing the Biofeedback & Cognitive Neuroscience Laboratory within the department. Over nearly a decade of persistent effort, planning, and resource mobilization, he worked to develop a state-of-the-art research facility that supports scientific investigations in psychology and neuroscience.

Name: Dr. Astha Arora
Bio: As the Lab Coordinator of the Biofeedback & Cognitive Neuroscience Laboratory, Dr. Astha leads research initiatives integrating psychology, neuroscience, and psychophysiology. Her work emphasizes understanding the neural and physiological mechanisms underlying cognition, emotion, stress, and behaviour through advanced neurophysiological assessment techniques. She is passionate about developing innovative research, mentoring emerging scholars, and building national and international collaborations in cognitive neuroscience and mental health research.
